title: Total System Collapse
style: English, female aggrotech vocal, hard industrial techno, four-on-the-floor, distorted kick and bass, metallic percussion, acid sequencer, minor key, relentless full-power club mix, fully pitched angular singing, clipped rhythmic phrases, no rap, no hip-hop groove, no R&B, no pop sweetness, no soft vocal, no half-time, no quiet breakdown, 146 BPM, 4/4 meter, Total System Collapse; story arc: A city loses its grid, finds one another in the dark, and replaces the command network with a human signal.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Red lights climb the grid wall
Warning sirens split the hall
Boots strike sparks across the grate
We arrive before the gate is sealed
Pressure climbs, the current screams
Steel wakes up inside the steam
Every breath becomes a vow
There is no surrender now

[Pre-Chorus]
Feel the charge, the breakers wake
Every chain is ours to break
One more step, the systems stall
Hear the future through the wall

[Chorus]
Total collapse, total war
Break it open, give them more
Nuclear pulse through every wire
Burn it all in digital fire
[Verse 2]
Map the pipes and mark the seams
Cut through locks and laser beams
Crew in formation, shoulder tight
We turn the blackout into light
Guards retreat behind the glass
We make the first switchyard pass
Hands on the wheel, eyes on the control core
The old regime can rule no more

[Bridge]
Hold the line, the engines roar
Strike the lock and take the floor
No retreat and no disguise
We write the ending with our eyes
[Verse 3]
Red dust rolls across the floor
The switchyard shakes the door
Heat turns midnight into white
We hold the line through violent light
One by one the towers bend
Every false command must end
When the shockwave splits the sky
We stand together, still alive

[Pre-Chorus]
Feel the charge, the breakers wake
Every chain is ours to break
One more step, the systems stall
Hear the future through the wall

[Chorus]
Total collapse, total war
Break it open, give them more
Nuclear pulse through every wire
Burn it all in digital fire
[Verse 4]
dark dust falls slow on broken rails
A distant engine starts and wails
We find the names the screens erased
We carry every lost face
From the ruins cables rise
New hands rebuild beneath the skies
The pulse returns, a harder drum
A different age has finally come

[Instrumental]

[Bridge]
Let the sirens mutate and climb
Metal heartbeat, perfect time
Keep the pressure, keep it tight
Turn the blackout into light
[Verse 5]
We tune the scars into a song
The rebuilt streets pull us along
No throne remains above the crowd
Our signal hits the skyline loud
The control core is cold, the night is clear
We earned the morning we can hear
The future answers beat by beat
A human heart beneath the heat

[Pre-Chorus]
Feel the charge, the breakers wake
Every chain is ours to break
One more step, the systems stall
Hear the future through the wall

[Chorus]
Total collapse, total war
Break it open, give them more
Nuclear pulse through every wire
Burn it all in digital fire
[Verse 6]
Count the sparks and count the days
We keep the fire, change its ways
No machine will choose our name
No fear can own this living flame
If the old walls rise again
We meet them as a hundred friends
From final ash to open track
We burn forward and don’t look back

[Instrumental]

[Bridge]
Let the sirens mutate and climb
Metal heartbeat, perfect time
Keep the pressure, keep it tight
Turn the blackout into light

[Final Chorus]
Total collapse, total war
Break it open, give them more
Nuclear pulse through every wire
Burn it all in digital fire
Total collapse, total war
Break it open, give them more
Nuclear pulse through every wire
Burn it all in digital fire

[Outro]
The signal lives, the signal stays
We build the next and change the ways
